account-locked: Konti yafunzwe by'agateganyo kubera kugerageza kwinjira kwananiranye kenshi cyane. Nyamuneka wongere ugerageze nyuma.
cloud-panel-not-allowed: Cloud Panel ni iya SuperAdmin gusa, kuri domeni ya Cloud Panel.
cloud-settings-desc: Hamwe na WeKan muri Weddy, Cloud Panel itanga domeni nyinshi za WeKan kuri seriveri imwe, buri imwe ifite amakuru yayo. Kuri domeni ya Cloud Panel, SuperAdmin acunga domeni na CloudFlare.
cloudflare-api-key-desc: Ufite urufunguzo rwa CloudFlare API, domeni ifite zone iri muri konti yawe ya CloudFlare ihabwa inyandiko ya DNS inyura kuri proxy n'icyemezo cya CloudFlare Origin. Izindi domeni zihabwa icyemezo cya Let's Encrypt. Urufunguzo rubikwa kuri seriveri kandi ntiruzongera kugaragazwa.
cloudflare-api-key-not-set: Nta rufunguzo rwa CloudFlare API rwabitswe: buri domeni ihabwa icyemezo cya Let's Encrypt.
error-notAuthorized: Nta burenganzira ufite bwo kureba uru rupapuro.
